---
title: "12 · Reliability and delivery"
---

How does the system resume accurately when infrastructure fails?

## Concepts

Choose deadlines, retry policies, idempotency keys, and atomic state changes. Design for duplicates and ambiguous outcomes before adding parallel execution.

## Study task

Trace a worker crash after scoring and before publishing its report. Show how two attempts with the same trial ID converge on a single recorded result.

## Deliverable

Submit a failure matrix and a release plan with success, timeout, and rollback criteria.
